summary: Learn ODK Central deployment, Docker Compose checks, PostgreSQL recovery planning, and upgrade operations. Explore the five-day training course.
lede: ODK server management covers operating and deploying ODK Central for administrators and support teams maintaining field-data services. The practical work includes checking Linux host readiness and Docker Compose settings, mapping ODK Collect and Enketo submission flows, validating PostgreSQL backup and restore steps, and preparing monitoring, upgrade, access-review, and handover records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who install, administer, support, or oversee ODK Central services and the field-data workflows connected to them.
prerequisites: Basic Linux command-line use is expected. Familiarity with containers is helpful; programming is not required. Bring a laptop and access to a Linux host or virtual machine where Docker Engine and Docker Compose can run. No separate PostgreSQL installation is needed for the ODK Central deployment exercises.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
